ledger: Kitchen: Contains stove, countertop microwave, cabinets. Doorway on left leads to Hallway.
Hallway: Connects Kitchen (entry from left) and Bedroom (entry from right). Ends at French doors.
Bedroom: Contains bed, chandelier, windows. Doorway leads back to Hallway.
Traversal: Woman walks Kitchen -> Hallway -> Bedroom -> Hallway -> Kitchen area.

findings.description: Upon returning to the kitchen area, the fixture above the stove has changed from upper cabinets (visible at 00:01) to an over-the-range microwave (visible at 00:09). This implies the traversal led to a second copy of the kitchen or an unexplained physical change in the same space without a time skip.
